svg.text: Kit 75 px, Ricky 79 px (real renders). ATS estimate 92 px facing the camera, on free grass nearer the camera (left of Ricky).
Grey: body 18 vs grass 1.74:1, so the ink outline, the ink treads, the ink screen and the slot carry the read.
In grey: a mid-grey head and body split by the dark neck band, a dark face band, a dark slot, a dark base.
